Whether you're here for leisure, culture, or culinary exploration, this high-end apartment is the perfect base for an unforgettable experience in the heart of Athens.

Enjoy full and exclusive access to the entire apartment – your own private retreat in the heart of the city.

listings.name: Apollon Family Apartment by zeussuites
listings.description:
A charming stay with character in the heart of Patision.
This apartment is located in one of the most historic buildings in the area, known for its classic Athenian architecture. The building itself features an impressive marble entrance and timeless construction that speaks to the elegance of early 20th-century design. High ceilings, vintage elements, and authentic materials create a warm, nostalgic atmosphere — perfect for those who appreciate character and history in their stay.

The building holds historical significance, as it once served as the residence for ambassadors, making it a landmark of both diplomatic and architectural importance.

Situated on Patision Avenue, the apartment is just a 7-minute walk from the National Archaeological Museum of Athens, one of the most important museums in the world dedicated to ancient Greek art. The museum houses an extensive collection of artifacts from prehistoric times to late antiquity, offering a deep insight into Greece’s rich history and cultural legacy.

The location is also very convenient:

Just 5 minutes on foot from Victoria Station (Green Line)

And from this point on Patision, you can even catch a glimpse of the Acropolis in the distance — a perfect reminder of the city's ancient splendor (please note: this view is from the street, not from the apartment itself).

Whether you're visiting for leisure, history, or convenience, this stay offers a unique and memorable Athenian experience.

listings.name: Museum Family Apartment by Zeussuites
listings.description:
A charming stay with character in the heart of Patision.
This apartment is located in one of the most historic buildings in the area, known for its classic Athenian architecture. The building itself features an impressive marble entrance and timeless construction that speaks to the elegance of early 20th-century design. High ceilings, vintage elements, and authentic materials create a warm, nostalgic atmosphere — perfect for those who appreciate character and history in their stay.

The building holds historical significance, as it once served as the residence for ambassadors, making it a landmark of both diplomatic and architectural importance.

Situated on Patision Avenue, the apartment is just a 7-minute walk from the National Archaeological Museum of Athens, one of the most important museums in the world dedicated to ancient Greek art. The museum houses an extensive collection of artifacts from prehistoric times to late antiquity, offering a deep insight into Greece’s rich history and cultural legacy.

The location is also very convenient:

Just 5 minutes on foot from Victoria Station (Green Line)

And from this point on Patision, you can even catch a glimpse of the Acropolis in the distance — a perfect reminder of the city's ancient splendor (please note: this view is from the street, not from the apartment itself).

Whether you're visiting for leisure, history, or convenience, this stay offers a unique and memorable Athenian experience.
